title: Notify the Commissioner of a land lease community
what: Notify the Commissioner of the community's particulars for the Register within 30 days of starting to operate it, and of any change within 30 days.

sources.title: Residential (Land Lease) Communities Act 2013 (NSW)
sources.publisher: NSW Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: The operator of a community must notify the Commissioner, in accordance with this section, of the following particulars so as to enable the Commissioner to include information about the community in the Register

sources.title: Residential (Land Lease) Communities Act 2013 (NSW)
sources.publisher: NSW Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: The operator of a community must notify the Commissioner within 30 days of any change to the particulars previously notified

reach.condition: if it operates a residential land lease community
